description_en: Executes a scaling rule. To adjust the number of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances or elastic container instances, you can manually execute a scaling rule or enable Auto Scaling to execute a scaling rule. You can call the ExecuteScalingRule operation to execute simple scaling rules or step scaling rules. Auto Scaling automatically executes target tracking scaling rules and predictive scaling rules on your behalf without requiring explicit execution calls
description_zh: 执行伸缩规则可以实现手动或自动调整ECS实例或ECI实例资源。其中，对于简单规则和步进规则，您才可以调用API ExecuteScalingRule执行一条伸缩规则，而对于目标追踪规则和预测规则，弹性伸缩会自动执行伸缩规则
name: ExecuteScalingRule

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the scaling rule.

You can call this operation to execute simple scaling rules and step scaling rules. If you want to call this operation to execute a step scaling rule, you must specify `BreachThreshold` and `MetricValue`
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩规则唯一标识符。

调用API执行伸缩规则时，只支持执行简单规则和步进规则，且执行步进规则时必须同时指定`BreachThreshold`和`MetricValue`
parameters.name: scaling_rule_ari

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The threshold specified when the step scaling rule is executed. Valid values: -9.999999E18 to 9.999999E18
parameters.help_zh: 执行步进伸缩规则时指定的当前阈值，取值范围：-9.999999E18~9.999999E18
parameters.name: breach_threshold

parameters.help_en: The metric value specified when the step scaling rule is executed. Valid values: -9.999999E18 to 9.999999E18
parameters.help_zh: 执行步进伸缩规则时指定的当前指标值，取值范围：-9.999999E18~9.999999E18
parameters.name: metric_value

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id
